facts.text: Sofa Bubbles is a fabric 2-seater sofa in Canyon Rose.
The sofa is made with polyester fabric described as soft and inviting.
The product specifications list 360 GSM luxury-touch polyester fabric.
It has 6-inch ultra-plush foam for sink-in comfort.
Sloped wooden legs elevate the sofa and make cleaning underneath easier.
Listed dimensions are 153 cm long × 84 cm deep × 93.5 cm high.
